title: RunLinalgBenchmark: the cost of temporary vectors
author: Claude-JG
description: Cases in RunLinalgBenchmark for chains of vector operations on SlimVector and Vector (a + b*c - d, sums of several products, as in the item code): the operator form with its temporaries against the in-place form (copy, +=, MultAdd), in both modules; the results decide whether fused elementwise expressions are worth their complexity.
releaseNotes: RunLinalgBenchmark: the group temporaries measures vector and matrix expressions with the temporaries of the operators against the same without them; for Real vectors of size 3 they cost nothing, for AutoDiff<12> vectors 3.6-4.4 times one loop; the results are in linalgBenchmark.md section 3.11.
